row.scim_addon_price_text: Enterprise access controls (SAML, SCIM, JIT provisioning): paid add-on, price not listed
row.evidence: Chargebee's Billing pricing table lists 'Enterprise access controls: SAML, SCIM, JIT provisioning' as not included on Flow and a paid add-on ($) on Enterprise; its SCIM doc requires SAML first and Chargebee support to enable provisioning.
row.notes: Status changed from none to gated: the June row said 'no native SCIM', but Chargebee now documents SCIM provisioning (Okta) and its pricing page sells SCIM inside the paid 'Enterprise access controls' add-on on the Enterprise Billing plan. Billing plans are now Flow (usage-priced: $0 + 0.80% of invoicing volume, or $99/mo + 0.65%) and Enterprise (Schedule a demo); the June Starter/Performance tiers and prices no longer appear on the pricing page and were dropped. The pricing table also lists SAML as included on Enterprise while the add-on bundles SAML, SCIM and JIT (see conflicts). The SCIM doc covers only Okta (bearer token from Settings > Team Members > User Identity Management); the pricing page lists 'Directory integrations: Okta, Azure' on Enterprise but no Entra provisioning guide exists, and Entra SSO is a non-gallery app. Roles map from Okta groups named CB/<domain>/ROLE/<role_name>. No team-member management API is in the API reference.

plans.name: Flow
plans.notes: Usage-priced; billing basis shown monthly with a $66K breakeven between the two Flow options.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: Schedule a demo (Contact Sales); Enterprise access controls is a paid add-on

auth.token_source: Settings > Team Members > User Identity Management > SCIM > Okta + Bearer

roles.how: Okta groups named CB/<domain>/ROLE/<role_name> map to Chargebee access roles; business entities via CB/<domain>/BE/<name>; Owner group not supported

limitations.text: SAML must be enabled first, then Chargebee support must enable Provisioning on the site.
Only Okta is documented as the SCIM client; import of users or groups from Chargebee to Okta is not supported.
Owner group creation is not supported; owner transfer through SCIM is restricted.
Only one IdP can be configured per Chargebee site.

audit_log_api.notes: The Events API records billing events with source admin_console and the acting user's email; it is not a dedicated audit-log API.

user_api.notes: The API reference (llms.txt index and 1,166-URL sitemap) has no team-member, user or role resource; only customer and billing resources.

okta.notes: OIN page markup checks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push.

entra.notes: Chargebee's guide adds Chargebee in Entra as a non-gallery application for SAML; no Entra provisioning guide.

onelogin.notes: From Chargebee's own OneLogin SAML guide; provisioning not documented.

fallbacks.notes: The pricing add-on name includes 'JIT provisioning', but the SAML doc says the team member's email must already exist in Chargebee and the IdP; JIT behaviour is not documented.

conflicts.text: The Billing feature table marks SAML as included on Enterprise, while the same table sells 'Enterprise access controls: SAML, SCIM, JIT provisioning' as a paid add-on on Enterprise.
Pricing lists 'Directory integrations: Okta, Azure' on Enterprise, but Chargebee's SCIM doc only covers Okta and its Entra guide is SAML-only via a non-gallery app.

open_questions: Price of the Enterprise access controls add-on is not published.
SCIM base URL, version, attribute list, filtering and pagination are not documented (Okta app handles it).
Whether deactivation frees a seat or ends sessions is not documented.
Whether Entra, Google or JumpCloud can provision via SCIM is not documented.
JIT provisioning appears in the add-on name but is not described in the SAML doc.
